# The reply fails after the credit, and the read-back of the credit answers an HTTP error whose JSON body carries a status field that is not "applied".
# The reader must not trust that body: the undo cannot tell whether the credit stands, so it fails and posts no uncredit.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:sha256sum] [!exec:shasum] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

deskinit
deskfakes
subst home/.desk/config
env HOME=$WORK/home
env DESK_DIR=$WORK/desk

exec obeereal item add desk shift-1 --title 'Morning shift' --body-file body.txt
exec obeereal run shift-1 desk --workflow desk/workflow.star
stdout 'item shift-1 finished'

grep -count=1 '^credit-' writes.log
! grep '^uncredit-' writes.log
exec obeereal status item-desk-2-r1
stdout 'undo:write:credit#1\t.*\tfailed\t'
! exists mail.out

-- body.txt --
The morning shift.
-- home/.desk/config --
DESK_API=http://desk.test
MAILDIR=@WORK@/home/.desk/mail
CHAT_SPOOL=@WORK@/home/.desk/chat
CHAT_API=http://chat.test
MASK_SALT=testsalt
-- home/.desk/credential.header --
Authorization: Bearer TESTONLY
-- home/.desk/mail/cur/keep --
-- home/.desk/chat/keep --
-- home/.desk/mail/new/m1 --
Message-Id: <m1@mail.test>
From: Ann Smith <ann@example.com>
Subject: Refund BK-123456

Thanks, Ann Smith. Please refund 80 for BK-123456.
-- resp/_bookings_BK-123456 --
{"ref":"BK-123456","status":"cancelled","paid":120,"currency":"EUR","date":"2026-12-01","customer_name":"Ann Smith","customer_email":"ann@example.com","refunded":0}
-- resp/_eligibility_refund --
{"eligible":true}
-- resp/sendmail.fail --
-- resp/readback.fail --
{"status":"error"}
